paper_title: Computational analysis of peripheral blood smears detects disease-associated cytomorphologies

concerns_full.concern_text: How would the ML protocol work from a user/clinician perspective? Clinical applicability beyond research setting unclear.

paper_title: A machine learning-driven virtual biopsy system for kidney transplant patients

concerns_full.concern_text: Model trained on single-center data. Needs external validation across different transplant centers with different protocols.
Virtual biopsy cannot replace histological assessment — clinical deployment pathway unclear.

paper_title: Performance of deep-learning based approaches to improve polygenic scores

concerns_full.concern_text: Possible data leakage in UK Biobank phenotype evaluation — many phenotypes are correlated. Since authors trained on both simulated and real data, held-out test phenotypes may overlap with training set.

Limited benchmarking — should compare with PRSice and LDPred. Small observed contribution of nonlinearity could be due to suboptimal NN, not absence of nonlinearity. Should test boosted trees and SVMs too.
Simulations consider only two extremes (entirely additive OR entirely epistatic). Overly simplistic — real-world phenotypes have mixed architectures.

paper_title: A machine learning model using clinical notes to identify physician fatigue

concerns_full.concern_text: Physician fatigue ground truth is indirect (note quality proxies). Direct validation with fatigue surveys needed.
